about: Bois-des-Filion is a city on Montréal’s North Shore in Thérèse-De Blainville, on the Rivière des Mille Îles between Terrebonne and Lorraine. A compact riverside suburb with parks along the river, it is a distinct municipality—not Terrebonne or Lorraine next door. About 10,000 people live in Bois-des-Filion.
